episodes.title: FREE WILL FOR SALE? | How marketing cults control your mind | Dr. Mara Einstein X Brain Bar
episodes.description:
We like to think our choices are our own. Dr. Mara Einstein, marketing scholar and author, makes an unsettling case that many of them are engineered, and that the techniques doing the engineering are older and more familiar than we would like to admit.

Drawing a straight line from medieval religion to the modern feed, she shows how belonging has always come with pressure, and how that pressure has simply moved platforms. Today it lives in social media, where anxiety is not an accidental side effect but a business model. Influencers are incentivized to provoke one of two reactions, anxiety or awe, because both drive the engagement that pays the bills, which is why young people now face levels of anxiety they have never faced before.

From there she turns to the machinery itself. The recruitment and retention playbook of a cult, she argues, is the same shape as the marketing funnel every brand uses: awareness, consideration, conversion, and finally loyalty, the point at which devoted customers become what the industry now calls brand evangelists. And every funnel begins in the same place, by finding your pain point and targeting you through your vulnerability, because no advertisement has ever told you that you are perfect just the way you are.

This talk is an invitation to see the incentives behind the screen, to recognize the persuasion for what it is, and to ask an uncomfortable question. If our attention, our emotions, and our choices can all be bought, how free is our will really?
